Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Preset: Choose a ready-made patch; selecting one writes the other parameters, which you can then tweak. custom leaves them as they are.
Mixmode: How the oscillator pattern combines with the picture. blend: crossfade. key: pattern shows where the picture is dark (below Keylevel). multiply: darkens the picture by the pattern. difference: absolute difference.
Pattern: Strength of the oscillator pattern in the picture. 0 = picture only, 1 = full pattern.
Displace: How far the oscillators push the input image around (distortion amount). 0 = none. Scaled by band1 modulation.
Colorize: Amount of oscillator-driven hue rotation and RGB channel split on the input image. 0 = none.
Hue: Hue offset of the input image as a fraction of the colour wheel (0-1, wraps).
Keylevel: Luminance threshold (0-1) used by the key mix mode. Only affects Mixmode = key.
Kaleid: Number of kaleidoscope mirror segments. 0 or 1 = off, 2 and up folds the image.
Palette: Colour ramp used for the oscillator pattern: bone, chrome, red, rainbow or acid.
Contrast: Contrast of the oscillator pattern. 1 = neutral, higher gives harder bands.
Gamma: Gamma curve of the oscillator pattern. Higher values darken it and narrow the bright parts.
Scale: Global multiplier on all oscillator frequencies. 1 = unchanged, higher = finer patterns.
Rotspeed: Constant rotation of the whole patch in degrees per second. Negative rotates the other way.
Freqa: Oscillator A spatial frequency (stripe cycles across the frame). Higher = finer stripes.
Speeda: Oscillator A drift speed in cycles per second. Negative reverses direction.
Rota: Oscillator A stripe orientation in degrees.
Shapea: Oscillator A waveform: sine (smooth), square (hard bands) or saw (ramp).
Freqb: Oscillator B spatial frequency (stripe cycles across the frame). Bent by oscillator A.
Speedb: Oscillator B drift speed in cycles per second. Negative reverses direction.
Rotb: Oscillator B stripe orientation in degrees.
Shapeb: Oscillator B waveform: sine (smooth), square (hard bands) or saw (ramp).
Freqc: Oscillator C spatial frequency (stripe cycles across the frame). Bent by oscillators A and B.
Speedc: Oscillator C drift speed in cycles per second. Negative reverses direction.
Rotc: Oscillator C stripe orientation in degrees.
Shapec: Oscillator C waveform: sine (smooth), square (hard bands) or saw (ramp).
Modulate: Cross-modulation: how much each oscillator bends the next one's coordinates. 0 = independent straight stripes.
Feedback: Strength of the 6-tap zoom/rotate echo trail that is max-blended over the picture. 0 = off, 0.95 max. Boosted by band3.
Echozoom: Zoom per echo tap. Above 1 trails shrink toward the centre, below 1 they grow outward.
Echorot: Rotation in degrees added per echo tap.
Echospacing: Time offset in seconds between echo taps. Larger values make the trails more spread out in time.
